scope: Broaden the source-backed open-source comparison for explicit DXF 3D geometry, DXF modern ASM carrier access, ezdxf ACIS subset parsing/export, LibreDWG's reported modern AcDs loss, and the boundary between carrier correctness and shape semantics.

method.kind: Primary project documentation and issue review
method.evidenceBoundary: GDAL and ezdxf statements are project documentation. LibreDWG #1411 is an open reporter account, not an independently reproduced result or a claim about current master. ODA §24 is an existing specification reference already reviewed in the plan, not a new source inspected during this pass. No peer runtime, local code behavior, DWG/DXF file, or shape semantics were tested in this research pass.

evidence.topic: GDAL explicit-geometry projection versus modern raw ASM access
evidence.observed: GDAL documents explicit DXF entity support through OGR geometry projection, including 3DFACE and POLYFACE mapping, and separately states that it cannot transform 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY/SURFACE into OGR geometry. DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE=TRUE exposes raw ASMData and a 12-real ASMTransform for DXF AC1027 and later. Curves may be tessellated, and this is not preservation of the complete CAD graph.
doesNotEstablish: DWG read or write support through the DXF driver
B-rep construction, validation, or curved-surface semantics
that binary-DXF reading and modern ASM field extraction compose on every build
exact preservation of entity owner, block, layout, and reference graph
evidence.planUse: Keep separate optional comparator lanes: projected explicit geometry and raw modern-DXF ASM carrier extraction. For carrier checks record handle/class, exact bytes/hash/length, ASMTransform, and owning block/reference placement separately. Pin GDAL build and independently prove binary-input capability before using that route.

evidence.topic: ezdxf's limited ACIS parse, export, and mesh profile
evidence.observed: The ACIS tools documentation describes limited load/parse and create/export of simple known structures, explicitly says arbitrary existing ACIS editing is not a goal, and warns unsupported ACIS records are represented as NONE_ENTITY with their data lost. The API documents SAT v700 for R2000-R2010 and SAB v21800 for R2013/R2018. mesh_from_body projects only flat polygonal Face entities; curved faces and surfaces require a kernel that ezdxf does not provide.
doesNotEstablish: arbitrary SAT/SAB parse and lossless re-export
complete body/reference closure for real producer outputs
curved B-rep validity or analytic shape correctness
the exact runtime behavior of a separately acquired package without running it
DWG AcDs association or DataStorage semantics
evidence.planUse: Treat ezdxf as a bounded DXF/ACIS parser-producer for exact supported profiles. Capture unsupported/NONE_ENTITY dispositions and diagnostics. Use it for controlled flat-polyhedron vectors only; do not grant carrier-preservation or curved-shape credit from an entity surviving load/save.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG reported R2013+ AcDs/SAB silent-loss route
evidence.observed: Open issue #1411 reports R2013+ REGION/3DSOLID/BODY geometry stored in AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b rather than inline. Its author describes a locally generated AC1032 DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF case where the REGION entity remains while the 5,489-byte SAB body and ACDSDATA records disappear, and mentions a non-shareable R2018 drawing. The issue body identifies LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at commit prefix 8a1ae764.
doesNotEstablish: that the issue was reproduced in this review
behavior of current LibreDWG master or another release
a normative container or ACIS semantic rule
a libdxfrw defect or complete LibreDWG feature profile
evidence.planUse: Use this only as a peer-reported silent-loss test pattern. At an exact pinned peer checkpoint compare source entity inventory, carrier bytes, AcDs/modeler identity and ownership, output ACDSDATA/inline payload route, and diagnostic disposition separately. A surviving typed entity and successful exit are insufficient.

evidence.observed: ODA's DWG specification documents the surrounding AcDs/DataStorage organization while limiting its knowledge of detailed ACIS/SAB internals. The plan's existing source review separately tracks record/page framing, entity/modeler association, carrier bytes, and geometry semantics.
doesNotEstablish: complete ACIS grammar or validity of SAB body topology
that one open-source parser/kernel is a complete semantic authority
native CAD acceptance of a carrier-preserved payload
evidence.planUse: Use separate acceptance labels for structure validity, carrier binding, carrier emission, complete ACIS parse, shape validation, and native consumer acceptance. Keep explicit mesh/polyface projection distinct from ACIS-backed solids.

nextActions: Continue local implementation using existing fast targeted tests; optional peer/native checks remain composed-only.
Keep explicit 3D entity modes, inline SAT/SAB, DXF ACDSDATA, DWG AcDs association, and B-rep semantics as separate routes and evidence cells.
At the modern carrier checkpoint, assert exact source identity, owner/modeler binding, payload hash and transform independently from block/INSERT placement.
If GDAL is present, use the pinned exact build for an optional raw ASM/transform comparison and a separate explicit-geometry projection check.
If ezdxf is used, pin its exact release, record unsupported ACIS records, and restrict mesh semantics to flat polygonal faces.
Do not use the open LibreDWG issue as current-master evidence without a pinned build and reproducible run.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; no evidence in this review promotes support claims.
